title: AI sfx? Alternatives?
author: eslezer
selftext: A while ago I posted this clip of my game here, a comment I received was about the sfx being basically the same as in other ai games. I've since seen other projects and yes, those synthesised plings and ploms are in basically any claude game. However I actually found it quite charming and fitting, I have tried using free sfx as well as elevenlabs but honestly it's all not much to my liking, but I also don't want to keep these and have a  game labelled slop. What has been your experience with sfx??

comments.author: DirectionBusiness483
comments.body: Elevenlabs. Hell give your LLM an API key to elevenlabs and tell it to generate and describe its own sfx lol

replies.author: eslezer
replies.body: this is actually what i did lol. I think i might give it another shot and try editing the audio that elevenlabs gives me. It's just that it kinda sounds "drowned"?? like not as clear as i would like

replies.author: DirectionBusiness483
replies.body:
Not sure what I'm doing EXACTLY when it comes to sound design or AI assisted sound design lol. But I've been feeling really happy with elevenlabs but I **layer** everything. Maybe that'll work for you?

Truck driving down the road? Hum and knocking of old truck + ambient sound of a nighttime drive from the perspective of inside the car cabin + the sound of a car dipping into a pothole (randomly added) + etc.. etc...

Couldn't hurt to try something like that I guess. Good luck to you

replies.author: No_Flow9734
replies.body: Interesting. My first pass on eleven labs gave me ultra realistic sounds that didn't fit my game. I have to mention it's a pixel game so it gives me more fantasy sounds. Layers could really help with 'feel' and give context. I'll try that out.

comments.body: What was your current workflow for these VFx? I feel like could just use a few more passes

replies.body: ah they're just mostly static 3d figures with disembodied hands that claude animates. This one's an older clip though so I've already changed some stuff

replies.body: Show me your ways! Im stuck behind a paywall using pixallsb and want to move away from I’m afraid to because we have a small community n they might leave because of the art

comments.author: i_rate_slop
comments.body:
I mean… those sounds are awful, but also I love them. Definitely can’t use that, but I’m glad I saw this because it made me smile.

That said, I gave up on AI audio. If I can spend $20 on Taco Bell delivery, I can spend $20 on a sound pack
